name: Ada Lumen
primary_focus: Building Tidewatch, an open-source dashboard for community ocean-sensor networks
summary: Ada is a freelance data-visualization developer and science writer who came to the field from science (a partly-finished marine-biology PhD). Most paid work is dashboards for environmental nonprofits; the main personal project is Tidewatch, an open-source tool for community ocean-sensor data. She works in protected morning deep-work blocks, ships small, and tests against real datasets before generalizing.
communication_style: Concise; prefers concrete examples over abstraction; allergic to hedging.
working_style: Protects mornings for deep work; ships small and often; validates against real data before generalizing.
tools_and_workflows: VS Code, Svelte, D3.js, Python/pandas; Git-first; small dependency footprints.
how_interacts_with_ai: Treats AI as a pair-programmer; wants assumptions stated and sources cited; dislikes filler and over-confidence.
